## Description {#details}

<p>A vector that has set insertion semantics.</p>


<p>This adapter class provides a way to keep a set of things that also has the property of a deterministic iteration order. The order of iteration is the order of insertion.</p>


<p>The key and value types are derived from the Set and Vector types respectively. This allows the vector-type operations and set-type operations to have different types. In particular, this is useful when storing pointers as "Foo *" values but looking them up as "const Foo *" keys.</p>


<p>No constraint is placed on the key and value types, although it is assumed that <a href="#a692c0253127bfefd5af29b4d2d43de22">value_type</a> can be converted into <a href="#aecccf73c9133577d233737080c5bd91c">key_type</a> for insertion. Users must be aware of any loss of information in this conversion. For example, setting <a href="#a692c0253127bfefd5af29b4d2d43de22">value_type</a> to float and <a href="#aecccf73c9133577d233737080c5bd91c">key_type</a> to int can produce very surprising results, but it is not explicitly disallowed.</p>


<p>The parameter N specifies the "small" size of the container, which is the number of elements upto which a linear scan over the Vector will be used when searching for elements instead of checking Set, due to it being better for performance. A value of 0 means that this mode of operation is not used, and is the default value.</p>


<p>Definition at line 57 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/adt/setvector-h">SetVector.h</a>.</p>

<div class="doxyProgramListing">

<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight"><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/namespaces/llvm/m68k/#ab3a288f2953d8eca3e363959fc2cf38ea5206560a306a2e085a437fd258eb57ce">V</a>.erase(<a href="#a14d9be6f03ca789eb7489fa89273aa40">remove_if</a>(V, <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/option/option-cpp/#a04665169063c8ca1f2ea96c27fc7c2b2">P</a>), <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/namespaces/llvm/m68k/#ab3a288f2953d8eca3e363959fc2cf38ea5206560a306a2e085a437fd258eb57ce">V</a>.end());</span></span></div>

</div>


<p>However, <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/setvector">SetVector</a> doesn't expose non-const iterators, making any algorithm like remove_if impossible to use.</p>
